records.title: #304 save-as-copy on: original survives, a cleaned copy appears
records.affectedScope: save-as-copy cleaning writes the original file instead of preserving it and creating a cleaned copy

records.title: #240 stripped MP4 does not retain create-date metadata
records.affectedScope: MP4 files with QuickTime CreateDate, TrackCreateDate, or MediaCreateDate values processed through ExifCleaner 4.0.0
records.impact: A cleaned MP4 may still include original create-date metadata values.
records.workaround: For sensitive MP4s, run ExifTool manually with -CreateDate= -TrackCreateDate= -MediaCreateDate= after cleaning, then verify those tags are absent.
